bases.name: Aspirus MedEvac Air 2 / Med-Trans – Mosinee, WI
bases.limitation: Approximate publicly mapped Spirit/Aspirus hangar reference at Central Wisconsin Airport (CWA). Aspirus and the airport confirm the Air 2 airport base; the hangar footprint was checked against aerial imagery. Exact current aircraft parking position is not surveyed.

finding: Two Aspirus hospital programs with publicly identified Med-Trans aircraft operations are included. Their absence from the membership base list and operator locator is not treated as proof of absence. Inclusion identifies the aviation relationship, not membership benefits or coverage eligibility.
